lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgMo4 (Mg2Mo8) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 10 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mo centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Mo and 6 Mg), while Mg centers have 16 neighbors (12 Mo and 4 Mg), both described as close-packed-like local arrangements. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and face sharing between 12-vertex Mo and 16-vertex Mg polyhedra, corner, edge, and face sharing between Mo polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Mg polyhedra.
